screenshots.description: Primary heading text is cut off underneath, showing that text metrics, line-height, overflow, or viewport positioning were not protected.
screenshots.correction: Protect heading boxes with real line-height, vertical padding, overflow strategy, and screenshot checks. Important text must never be cropped by parent containers or viewport framing.
scorecardCaps: primary heading or important text clipped max 3
text visibly escapes or is cut off max 2-3

screenshots.description: Pattern canvas shows overlapping pattern pieces, callouts, chips, ruler labels, construction lines, and labels with no credible collision model.
screenshots.correction: Define coordinate, layer, object, label, and callout models before drawing. Reserve protected label lanes, route callouts outside shapes, and run diagram integrity QA.
scorecardCaps: diagram/canvas has no collision model max 4

screenshots.description: Close-up shows badge, label, measurement, and piece-name layers colliding into an unreadable diagram. This also implies heavy overdraw and interaction/performance risk.
screenshots.correction: Reduce competing layers, define label priority and protected zones, separate badges/callouts from core labels, and enforce a canvas performance budget.
scorecardCaps: selected state or badge obscures core data max 4
